speaker: BOSS (D. Marsh, Kettle Base)

steps.name: Look around and move
steps.objective: Look around the cab, then walk to the window and back.
steps.prompt_pc: Mouse to look, W A S D to walk
steps.prompt_phone: Drag right side of screen to look, left joystick to walk

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Elgo Tower, Kettle Base. It's well after dark. You awake up there? Take a second. Have a look around the cab.

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Get your legs under you. Walk over to the window and back.

steps.name: Use the binoculars
steps.objective: Raise the binoculars and scan the ridge.
steps.prompt_pc: Hold Right Mouse Button or press B for binoculars
steps.prompt_phone: Tap the binoculars icon, drag to scan

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Binoculars are on the desk. Pick them up and scan the east ridge for me. Moon's up, so you should see fine.

step_complete_line.speaker: BOSS
step_complete_line.text: That's the idea. Nice and slow.

steps.name: Tower floodlight
steps.objective: Hold the floodlight switch to light the area in front of the tower, then release.
steps.prompt_pc: Hold E to use the floodlight

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: It's dark out there. There's a floodlight switch by the window. Hold it down and it lights up the ground in front of you. Let go and it shuts off. It runs on the generator, so don't leave it burning.

step_complete_line.speaker: BOSS
step_complete_line.text: Good. Lights out, easy on the generator.

steps.name: Flashlight
steps.objective: Equip the flashlight and toggle it on and off.
steps.prompt_pc: Press 2 to equip the flashlight, Left Mouse Button to switch it on or off
steps.prompt_phone: Tap the flashlight icon, then tap the fire button to toggle

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Your flashlight's in the desk drawer. Take it out, then click it on. Click again to turn it off.

step_complete_line.speaker: BOSS
step_complete_line.text: Good. Batteries are fresh, but save them.

steps.name: Spot and report the smoke
steps.objective: Find the glow and smoke plume on the east ridge and report it by radio.
steps.prompt_pc: Press E to use the radio
steps.prompt_phone: Look at the radio and tap USE (it turns into RADIO)

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Got a call from the next district. They saw a glow on that ridge. Look about two o'clock.

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: See it? Orange glow under a pale column of smoke, lit up by the moon. Key the radio and report it.

step_complete_line.speaker: BOSS
step_complete_line.text: Copy that, smoke and glow on the east ridge. Crew's rolling. Good work.

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Now, the nine millimeter. It's in your holster. Get it out. Protection only.

step_complete_line.speaker: BOSS
step_complete_line.text: Good. Keep your finger off the trigger until you mean it.

steps.name: Aim down sights
steps.objective: Aim through the red dot sight.
steps.prompt_pc: Hold Right Mouse Button to aim
steps.prompt_phone: Hold the aim button on the right

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Raise it. Put the red dot on the lit target on the tall mast just east of the tower.

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Squeeze off one round at the target. Just one. Rounds are limited up there.

step_complete_line.speaker: BOSS
step_complete_line.text: Good shot. Remember, fifty rounds, no more.

boss_lines.speaker: BOSS
boss_lines.text: Last thing. Reload. Drop the mag and seat a fresh one.

step_complete_line.speaker: BOSS
step_complete_line.text: That's it. You're set. Stay up, watch, and call in anything you see. Kettle Base out.

pc.binoculars: Hold Right Mouse Button or B

phone.floodlight: Hold the light button (release to turn off)
phone.flashlight_toggle: Fire button while flashlight is equipped

controls.note: E is context-sensitive: hold near the floodlight switch for light, press at the radio to report.

note: Prompt text uses default PC keys and touch labels; GD may rebind.
